title: Выход из укрытия: нестабильные попадания бластера и отсутствие повторного выхода

validation.scope: One hide/peek/fire/return cycle, not a complete fight

implemented: Wall occlusion from all observed supported threats, short grounded movement with hazard/mover/teammate checks
Blaster muzzle trajectory check and nearby verified peek search; suppress shots when the checked corridor closes
Live model cover choice and bounded firing exposure; return behind wall
Runner requires damage within the cover exposure window rather than elsewhere in the run
remaining_validation: Find remaining native misses; nominal muzzle ray is not a guarantee of accuracy or moving-target interception
Repeat peeks while the target is hidden; current System1 gate needs a visible combat target
Complete a fight without remaining indefinitely behind cover
Other weapons, unseen threats, explosive protection and grouped combat are not accepted
General episode dispatcher is not bound; use the specialized runner
